integration_issues.issue: Clicking open-email-draft on opp_sweeney fires POST /api/opportunities/opp_sweeney/handoff. The handoff endpoint only writes an audit log to the contact_handoffs collection (it does NOT mutate the opportunity), but the review spec literally says 'MUST NOT POST/PATCH to any /api/opportunities/* endpoint'. If the audit log is intentional, spec should be relaxed to 'no state change'; if the spec is strict, the client-side handoff logger needs to be removed or moved to a non-/api/opportunities route.

action_items: Confirm intent of POST /api/opportunities/{id}/handoff — either update spec (allow audit log) or stop client from POSTing on draft-open.
